title: What arrives where
caption: Delivery options and access requirements

rows.content: Live intraday targets with context, plus daily, weekly, monthly and historical analysis.
rows.access: All plans, within your licensed history.

rows.content: Newly generated targets sent to your systems during the session. Activation requires assisted setup and successful delivery verification.
rows.access: Desk: one initial live destination. Enterprise: scope by agreement. Not included with Core. Standard setup has no separate webhook fee; custom development is quoted separately.

rows.content: A completed-session report sent to verified recipients. Manage recipients and individual opt-outs in your organization settings.
rows.access: One recipient per licensed seat: 1 Core, 5 Desk, 15 Enterprise unless expanded by agreement.

rows.content: Completed-session daily statistics sent to a configured HTTPS destination.
rows.access: Desk: up to 5 destinations. Enterprise: up to 50.

rows.content: Daily reports, weekly reports and session history for your internal tools.
rows.access: Desk: 60 requests per minute. Enterprise: 600. Licensed history applies.

timing: The dashboard checks for updates every 60 seconds. Webhooks use a separate delivery path; this refresh interval is not a webhook delivery-time guarantee. Live-target connections are not activated automatically by subscribing. Daily-report destination limits are separate from live-target limits.
